name: University of Tennessee
academic_ranking: R1 doctoral (very high research). U.S. News 2026: tied 49th among public universities, tied 102nd among national universities. Undergraduate acceptance rate ~46% (2023 entering class); total enrollment ~40,784 with ~30,564 undergraduates.
financial_aid: Public flagship. 2025-26 annual tuition & mandatory fees: $13,876 in-state, $33,336 out-of-state (source: admissions.utk.edu, checked 2026-07). UT reports ~$79M in scholarships and financial aid offered to students in 2024. Tuition figure recorded here is out-of-state.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium in Knoxville (referenced on utsports.com softball pages).
program_reputation: Perennial SEC and national power. Long-tenured, nationally respected program led by head coach Karen Weekly; frequent NCAA Tournament / Women's College World Series participant.
notes: Data captured from live utsports.com softball coaches and roster pages on 2026-07-30 (pages labeled 2027 season). IMPORTANT: an initial CDN fetch returned cross-tenant cached content (Ohio Dominican University) via the shared Sidearm/Imperva cache; that data was discarded and a clean re-fetch verified as University of Tennessee (title '2027 Softball Coaches - University of Tennessee Athletics', 0 ohiodominican references) was used. NCAA D1 softball scholarship_count set to the D1 equivalency maximum of 12 (not published per-school on the athletics site). No individual coach twitter/X handles are listed in the staff directory (team account is @Vol_Softball).
